lexicalReview.metric: Jaccard of normalized stem words longer than three characters
lexicalReview.limitation: A low score cannot prove absence of semantic reuse. Flagged pairs require human review; source-based concept overlap is expected and is not itself a reused fact pattern.

itemWritingControl.characterization: Provider regression limit, not a regulator-prescribed or psychometric standard
itemWritingControl.repair: 75 distractors revised; correct answers, stems, rationales, IDs and objective assignments preserved

limits: The observed above-limit longest-answer cue is repaired and guarded; technical item-writing controls do not establish distractor performance or substantive approval
